Hello and welcome aboard from Aurelia Skyways. Friendly Pet Travel Notes

This week at the Companion Animal Travel Desk, our focus remains on calm preparation and clear handoffs. Travelers benefit when documents are checked early, carriers are reviewed carefully, and the welcome team gives every family a steady start. <<FACT F047>> Staff are also taking extra care with nervous travelers, because a quiet word and a patient pace can ease the whole journey.

If you are traveling with a pet, please keep essentials ready and follow each required step before boarding. Our coordinators and supervisors continue to listen closely, answer concerns with care, and help each trip begin in good order. We appreciate the trust placed in Aurelia Skyways, and we will keep working to make each journey more comfortable and orderly.
